Visitor replaces subscript with custom template

```typescript title="WebAssembly"

  const _testVisitor = {
    visitSubscript(ctx: any, text: any): string | { type: "custom"; output: string } {
        return { type: "custom", output: `~${text}~` };

    }

  const result = convert("<p>H<sub>2</sub>O is water.</p>", (() => { const _u = WasmConversionOptions.default(); _u.visitor = new WasmVisitorHandle(_testVisitor); return _u; })());
```
